description: Session folds with a female-only model: training and validation on female speakers, test on the whole held-out session (both speakers), so one run gives female to female, female to male and female to all. The baseline CNN of night 1, unchanged except for the data protocol, with seeds 1 to 5, so it can be set beside the session-out baseline (night 1 and cnn_confirm_1, same configuration and seeds). Part of the split plan of 2026-09-26 (project page 'IEMOCAP protocols and split plan'). One data protocol per sweep. Priority 90: right after cnn_confirm_1. Validation only until a selection file exists.
